Rescuing the two Tadi farm adults would require a 44-minute detour (Myagang to Tadi and back), which costs more than the 40 in penalties it would avoid, so they are deferred. Another plan with the same cost of 120 is one trip carrying 3 elderly and 1 adult, with the remaining 4 adults deferred.
